messages:
olivia: Quick flag — month-end revenue feed looks off, reserved commit margin is +$42.8k vs forecast. I traced it to vendor invoice lag from CloudRack; they haven't billed our reserved top-ups for Feb yet.

samir: Can you drop the invoice list and unbilled usage numbers here? :eyes:

olivia: SQL I used to pull unbilled vendor rows:
```
SELECT vendor, invoice_id, period_end, amount, billed_at
FROM vendor_invoices
WHERE vendor = 'CloudRack' AND period_end BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' AND billed_at IS NULL;
```
Sample result: 3 top-up lines, total amount = 42,800.00 USD, period_end 2026-02-28, vendor activity report attached in thread.

maya: If vendor invoices arrive after close we need an accrual. This is an estimate — controller sign-off required. What's the source of truth for the number?

olivia: Source = CloudRack activity report (PDF) + our usage meter. I reconciled meter -> customer invoices; customers already consumed the commit top-ups (we invoiced customers or applied credits). So P&L timing mismatch.

alex: From BillingOps: customers show consumption in the billing system, we already recognized customer revenue for hosted/dedicated usage. We haven't been billed by CloudRack for the reserved commit top-ups — so margin is overstated if we don't accrue.

kevin: Suggest we book an accrual for vendor payables (liability) for $42,800 and post a corresponding deferral/contra revenue entry to avoid overstating net revenue. Treat as vendor billing-lag accrual, not bad-debt.

maya: I need GL guidance and supporting schedule. Proposed JE: Dr Deferred Revenue Adj (4201) $42,800; Cr Accrued Vendor Invoices (2105) $42,800. Will annotate with vendor report and customer invoice mapping.

samir: That sounds reasonable. Samir (Finance) approves in principle pending upload of schedules and controller sign-off. Tagging anna (controller) in request.

maya: I'll prepare the JE and schedule and submit in Workday tomorrow AM (target 09:30 PT). Will include: vendor activity PDF, export of customer invoice IDs, and SQL results.

olivia: I'll export the customer invoice IDs for Acme / NimbusAI / ProtoLabs and paste them here in a minute.

accounting-bot: Reminder: month-end cutoff is 2026-02-28 23:59 PT. Auto-accrual run scheduled 2026-02-28 23:45 PT.

olivia: One more ask — can the JE narrative explicitly note that this is an invoice timing accrual due to vendor billing lag and not an allowance/bad-debt estimate? Auditors will want that detail.

maya: Yes — note will read: 'Accrual for vendor invoice timing lag (CloudRack) based on vendor activity report dated 2026-02-28; amount matches consumption-backed top-ups invoiced to customers.'

samir: Good. After vendor invoice arrives PaymentsOps should reconcile actual invoice vs accrual and post reversal/adjustment as needed.

alex: I'll create a PaymentsOps ticket to reconcile incoming CloudRack invoices and link it to the JE. Will notify when invoice lands.

kevin: :thumbsup: Thanks all.

olivia: Thanks — filing this thread into the month-end close bucket. Updating the close tracker with JE ID when Maya posts it.

maya: JE in draft will be uploaded by 09:30 PT tomorrow, tagging samir + anna for final sign-off.

samir: Closing this triage — accrual plan approved subject to supporting docs. Follow-up actions assigned.
